arxiv-1602-04860.title: Dual-context Calculi for Modal Logic Thanks: This is a revised and extended version of a paper presented at LICS 2017 [ Kav17 ] .
arxiv-1602-04860.creator: G. A. Kavvos
arxiv-1602-04860.description: Abstract . We present natural deduction systems and associated modal lambda calculi for the necessity fragments of the normal modal logics K, T, K4, GL and S4. These systems are in the dual-context style: they feature two distinct zones of assumptions, one of which can be thought as modal, and the other as intuitionistic.

arxiv-2012-07252.creator: Neeraj Kumar, Srishti Goel, Ankur Narang, Brejesh Lall
arxiv-2012-07252.description: Abstract The style of the speech varies from person to person and every person exhibits his or her own style of speaking that is determined by the language, geography, culture and other factors. Style is best captured by prosody of a signal.

arxiv-2312-10862.title: Cohomology and Homotopy of Lie triple systems
arxiv-2312-10862.creator: Haobo Xia, Yunhe Sheng, Rong Tang
arxiv-2312-10862.description: Abstract . In this paper, first we give the controlling algebra of Lie triple systems. In particular, the cohomology of Lie triple systems can be characterized by the controlling algebra. Then using controlling algebras, we introduce the notions of homotopy Nambu algebras and homotopy Lie triple systems.

arxiv-2412-11000.title: Upper limit of spin relaxation in suspended graphene
arxiv-2412-11000.creator: Aron W. Cummings, Simon M.-M. Dubois, Pedro Alcázar Guerrero, Jean-Christophe Charlier, Stephan Roche
arxiv-2412-11000.description: Abstract We use a combination of molecular dynamics and quantum transport simulations to investigate the upper limit of spin transport in suspended graphene. We find that thermally-induced atomic-scale corrugations are the dominant factor, limiting spin lifetimes to ∼ \sim 10 10 ns by inducing a strongly-varying local spin-orbit coupling.

arxiv-2502-16191.title: Multistate Control of Nonlinear Photocurrents in Optoferroelectrics via phase manipulation of light field
arxiv-2502-16191.creator: Ali Kazempour, Esmaeil Taghizadeh Sisakht, Mahmut Sait Okyay, Xiao Jiang, Shunsuke Sato, Noejung Park
arxiv-2502-16191.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ali Kazempour, Esmaeil Taghizadeh Sisakht, Mahmut Sait Okyay, Xiao Jiang, Shunsuke Sato, Noejung Park. Ultrafast optical control of ferroelectricity based on short and intense light can be utilized to achieve accurate manipulations of ferroelectric materials, which may pave a basis for future breakthrough in nonvolatile memories. Here, we demonstrate that phase manipulation of electric field in the strong field sub-cycle regime induces a nonlinear injection current, efficiently coupling with the topology of band structure and enabling dynamic reversal of both current and polarization.

arxiv-2503-23819.description: Abstract Deep learning based diagnostic AI systems based on medical images are starting to provide similar performance as human experts. arxiv-2601-02082.title: Realistic adversarial scenario generation via human-like pedestrian model for autonomous vehicle control parameter optimisation
arxiv-2601-02082.creator: Yueyang Wang, Mehmet Dogar, Russell Darling, Gustav Markkula
arxiv-2601-02082.description: Abstract Autonomous vehicles (AVs) are rapidly advancing and are expected to play a central role in future mobility. Ensuring their safe deployment requires reliable interaction with other road users, not least pedestrians. Direct testing on public roads is costly and unsafe for rare but critical interactions, making simulation a practical alternative.

pmc-10626733.description: BackgroundPrecise data about ATTR-CM incidence rates at national level are scarce.
